newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down as blue chips tumble.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down as blue chips tumble.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday blue chips tumbled, but short-covering by speculators checked the index's fall, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 12.15 points, or 0.89 percent, to end at 1,352.93. Losers led gainers 137 to 64.
"Selling in telecom utility PTCL, the market's driving force, further depressed sentiment," dealer Ali Raza said. "There's only bad news on the political and economic fronts."
PTCL fell 0.90 rupees to 30.75 and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 16.75. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
